A '''Utinni Effect''' is a kind of [[Effect]]. The name comes from the Jawa exclamation on the Interrupt [[Utinni!]].

Utinni Effects are deployed on a target (a location, character, or other card). They usually stay there until a character moves to that target to retrieve Force, take a card, or cancel the Effect.

[[Alter]] can cancel a Utinni Effect the same way it cancels other Effects. Retrieving or fulfilling the Utinni Effect is a separate action from canceling it with Alter.

Premiere examples: [[Death Star Plans]], [[Kessel Run]], [[Tusken Breath Mask]], [[Lateral Damage]] (Dark Side).

See also [[Utinni!]].
